finding: Rates of ectopic pregnancy, pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, preterm labor, premature rupture of membrane, and cesarean section were significantly higher among adolescents <15 years of age, with risk decreasing and becoming comparable to older mothers after 16 years of age.
mod_finding: The study found that rates of caesarean section were significantly higher among adolescents < 15 years of age compared to the control group.
